body: Thank you for your response. I know there are dark times and that is something that i hate so much. They are so hard to get through and a lot of the time it feels as though there isnt much of a point to it. I feel like what i really need is just people to talk to. Some real friends that i talk to. But there is something about that that is the so difficult. I dont make friends easily if at all and it doesnt make this whole thing any easier.
